notes.title: Small Patch version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, here's a small patch that tackles some issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug of ch2 exhibition area hotspots becoming non-interactable
[*] Improve ch2 museum distraction sequence visually
[*] Improve Raya character portrait
[*] Fixed some mindboard items showing blank on Steamdeck
[*] Fixed apartment chest bug exit button disappearing
[*] Fixed some localization issues for Korean language
[/list]

Thanks everyone for your support!
